===Overview=== *Integrated ADSL2+ DSL modem works with all ADSL providers :(''AT&T, Verizon, Centurylink, Qwest, Bell, Acanac, Teksavvy'') *Integrated 802.11bgn Wireless Router *Integrated 8 port managed Gigabit Ethernet switch with VLAN support. *Integrated VoIP (SIP and H.323) 4x FXS (RJ11) ports and 1 FXO (RJ11) port shared w/ ADSL2+. *Management: HTTP, HTTPS, SSH, Telnet, SNMPv1 and V3.
